name: Datasonic Group Berhad
summary: Datasonic Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides information communications technology (ICT) solutions in Malaysia. It operates through Customised Smart Card Solutions; Manufacturing; and Investment Holding segments. The company offers personalization of smart cards; and customization of software and hardware solutions. It also provides information technology, technical consultancy, financial consultancy and financial leasing, secure printing and document personalization, e-government and digital, and information technology consultation services; and machine learning, artificial intelligence, deep learning, other information technology, and biometrics solutions.
